item.description:
New (beta)

  • Quick Snap on the green button. Rest the pointer on any window's green button and WindowSmith's Quick Snap layouts appear beside it; click a zone to place that window, even one in the background. Turn it on in Settings → Green Button.
  • It replaces Apple's own green-button menu while it is on, and brings Apple's back when it is off. WindowSmith asks before changing this, and apps that are already open keep Apple's menu until they're reopened.
  • This is a beta, and off unless you turn it on. It watches mouse movement to notice the green button, which uses a little extra CPU and battery while the pointer is moving.
